info.title: VPSI School Management API
info.description:
ລະບົບບໍລິຫານຈັດການໂຮງຮຽນ — School Management System API.

All responses honour `Accept-Language` (`lo`, `en`) or `?lang=`. Every endpoint requires a bearer token unless marked otherwise, and is additionally gated by the role permission matrix.
